# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --workspace`, or listed checks that could not run below
- [ ] Ran Android or QML checks if those areas changed, or noted why they were skipped
- [ ] Updated docs for user visible or IPC changes
- [ ] Verified no secrets, credentials, message bodies, or private device data are included
- [ ] Kept the AGPL boundary for the Google Messages adapter intact, with no copied adapter or protocol code in this MIT repository

## Checks

List checks run and any that were unavailable. Note live tested results
separately from unverified behavior.
